entities.summary: Sufi Muhammad bin Alhazrat Hassan was a Pakistani Sunni Salafi Wahhabi cleric and militant, and the founder of Tehreek-e-Nafaz-e-Shariat-e-Mohammadi (TNSM), a militant group vying for implementation of his version of Sharia in Pakistan. It operated mainly in the Dir, Swat, and Malakand districts of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.
